Beginning at a point in the Southwesterly right of way line of Washington Avenue (40 feet wide) where intersected by the Northerly line of Lot 12.05 as shown on Plan hereinafter mentioned, said point being South 25 degrees 06 minutes 00 seconds East, 136.60 feet from the intersection of said right of way line of Washington Avenue with the Southeasterly line of Lot 12.12, Block 76 and running; thence

(2) Along said division line, South 61 degrees 23 minutes 09 seconds West, 71.11 feet to a point in the Northeasterly line of Lot 12.11 as shown on Plan hereinafter mentioned; thence

(3) Along the said Northeasterly line of Lot 12.11 and the Northeasterly line of Lot 12.10, North 28 degrees 36 minutes 51 seconds West, 20.05 feet to a point in the division line between Lots 12.04 and 12.05 as shown on Plan hereinafter mentioned; thence

(4) Along the said division line, North 61 degrees 23 minutes 09 seconds East 72.34 feet to the point and place of beginning.

notes: Checked against Book 7535 Page 930, PDF page 2 (Schedule C, File No. ITA6018), at 220-500 dpi: all four courses and figures match; the Schedule C's opening sentence ('ALL that certain lot, ... described as follows:') was added to the legal description and the printed double space in 'Lot 12.05  in Block' kept. Legal description transcribed verbatim from Schedule C (File No. ITA6018), Book 7535 Page 930, PDF page 2. Lot 12.05 is an interior lot in Willits Court fronting on Washington Avenue. PDF page 4 (Book 7535 Page 932) is the cover of a separate deed from Select Real Estate, LLC to Jay Rosan, and PDF page 5 (Page 932A) is Lot 12.04's Schedule C (ITA7807). Courses agree with the adjoining lots: the 136.60 ft tie equals Lot 12.04's 116.51 + 20.09 ft, course (2) 71.11 ft is Lot 12.06's course (4), and course (4) 72.34 ft is Lot 12.04's course (2). Closes at 0.0026 ft.
